acceptanceCriteria: ruby_discover_test.go (or its portable split) has no darwin||linux constraint and passes GOOS=windows go vet
POSIX-only cases, if any, are isolated in a constrained file with a comment naming why
body: Residual from V1-1810 (PR #1151 head a7f429dc0). The discovery helpers moved to the unconstrained discover_helpers_test.go, but internal/testvaliditydoc/ruby_discover_test.go keeps `//go:build darwin || linux`, so Ruby discovery tests never run on Windows. Expected: the portable parts run on every GOOS; truly POSIX-only cases are split out with a named reason.
title: testvaliditydoc: ruby_discover_test.go is still restricted to darwin||linux
